description: DB foundation: six tenant-owned Prisma models + four enums + additive back-relations, and the ONE hand-authored Phase-6 migration (diff → deploy → status). Mirrors the Phase-5 library migration section order a–j; ApplicationReview is append-only (Phase-4 attendance_record_history precedent). Leaves the migration's catalogue-seed section (j) as a placeholder filled by FEAT-002. Depends on nothing; FEAT-002/003/004 depend on it.
steps: Add to packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma (after the Phase-5 library models) the enums AdmissionCampaignStatus (DRAFT|OPEN|CLOSED), ApplicationStatus (DRAFT|SUBMITTED|UNDER_REVIEW|DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED|ELIGIBLE|SHORTLISTED|OFFERED|ACCEPTED|ENROLLED|REJECTED|WITHDRAWN), ApplicationReviewDecision (RECOMMEND_ELIGIBLE|RECOMMEND_REJECT|REQUEST_DOCUMENTS|SHORTLIST|NOTE), AdmissionOfferStatus (ISSUED|ACCEPTED|DECLINED|EXPIRED).

Add models AdmissionCampaign, AdmissionCampaignProgram (join), Application, ApplicationDocument, ApplicationReview (createdAt only; NO updatedAt — append-only), AdmissionOffer, Enrollment per design §5: each with institutionId, @@unique([id, institutionId]), the business uniques and @@index set in §5, and relation fields in the library-model style. Enrollment has @@unique([institutionId, applicationId]) (idempotency backstop).

Add additive back-relation arrays on Institution (admissionCampaigns, admissionCampaignPrograms, applications, applicationDocuments, applicationReviews, admissionOffers, enrollments), Program (campaigns/applications/offers back-relations), AcademicSession (campaigns, enrollments), StudentProfile (enrollments), User (applications). Do NOT change any existing column on student_profiles or users.
Build the api to validate the schema: `npm run build -w @campusgate/api`.

Hand-author packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261115000000_phase6_admissions/migration.sql following 20261108000000_phase5_library/migration.sql sections a–j. (a) CREATE TYPE the four enums. (b) CREATE TABLE the six tables + admission_campaign_programs (updatedAt NOT NULL on all except application_reviews). (c) (id,institutionId) uniques; business uniques ((institutionId,name) campaigns; (institutionId,applicationNumber) + (institutionId,campaignId,applicantUserId) applications; (institutionId,campaignId,programId) join; (institutionId,applicationId) UNIQUE enrollments); the §5 query indexes; the raw-SQL partial unique admission_offers_one_live_per_application on (institutionId,applicationId) WHERE status IN ('ISSUED','ACCEPTED'). (d) tenant-root FKs institutionId→institutions(id) RESTRICT on all seven. (e) composite same-tenant FKs incl. institutionId: campaign→session(nullable)/targetProgram(nullable); join→campaign/program; application→campaign/applicantUser(→users(institutionId,id))/program; document→application; review→application; offer→application/offeredProgram; enrollment→application/studentProfile(→student_profiles(institutionId,id))/academicSession. (f) CHECK non-empty campaign name, applicationNumber, document reference. (g) ENABLE+FORCE RLS: standard nullif-guarded select+modify pair on all tables EXCEPT application_reviews, which gets the append-only SELECT + INSERT-only pair (no FOR ALL/modify policy). (h) append-only trigger on application_reviews: copy the attendance_record_history_append_only function + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger shape (RAISE EXCEPTION ... USING ERRCODE='restrict_violation'). (i) guarded campass_app GRANT refresh: full DML on the six mutable tables + join; SELECT,INSERT + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE on application_reviews; never grant BYPASSRLS. (j) LEAVE a clearly-marked placeholder comment for the catalogue seed (permissions/roles/role_permissions) — FEAT-002 fills it with the pinned literal markers.

From packages/db, confirm the delta read-only: `npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma` and check it lists ONLY the new Phase-6 objects. NEVER run `prisma migrate dev`.
Apply: `npx prisma migrate deploy` (cwd packages/db), then `npx prisma migrate status` and confirm 'up to date'. Do not touch the 11 frozen dirs or _prisma_migrations.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` succeeds (prisma generate validates the six models + four enums; tsc green).
The pre-deploy `prisma migrate diff` shows only Phase-6 objects (no change to any frozen table's RLS/grant/FK).
`npx prisma migrate status` reports 'up to date' after deploy; exactly one new migration dir 20261115000000_phase6_admissions exists; the 11 frozen dirs and _prisma_migrations are unchanged.

application_reviews has the append-only policy pair (no modify policy), REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE from campass_app, and the BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger; the other five mutable tables + join have the standard select+modify pair.
verification: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma
cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma migrate status
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED (deployed to shared Supabase). Migration dir created: packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261115000000_phase6_admissions/migration.sql (sections a-j, mirrors phase5_library). migrate deploy applied ONLY this dir; migrate status = 'Database schema is up to date!' (12 migrations). 11 frozen dirs + _prisma_migrations untouched (git status shows only schema.prisma + the new dir changed).

NEW ENUMS (Prisma + Postgres TYPE names): AdmissionCampaignStatus (DRAFT|OPEN|CLOSED); ApplicationStatus (DRAFT|SUBMITTED|UNDER_REVIEW|DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED|ELIGIBLE|SHORTLISTED|OFFERED|ACCEPTED|ENROLLED|REJECTED|WITHDRAWN); ApplicationReviewDecision (RECOMMEND_ELIGIBLE|RECOMMEND_REJECT|REQUEST_DOCUMENTS|SHORTLIST|NOTE); AdmissionOfferStatus (ISSUED|ACCEPTED|DECLINED|EXPIRED).

NEW MODELS -> @@map table name: AdmissionCampaign -> admission_campaigns; AdmissionCampaignProgram -> admission_campaign_programs (join); Application -> applications; ApplicationDocument -> application_documents; ApplicationReview -> application_reviews (APPEND-ONLY, createdAt only, no updatedAt); AdmissionOffer -> admission_offers; Enrollment -> enrollments.

KEY RELATION FIELD NAMES (for FEAT-003/004 service code): AdmissionCampaign.{intakeSession,targetProgram(@relation "CampaignTargetProgram"),programs[],applications[]}; AdmissionCampaignProgram.{campaign,program}; Application.{campaign,applicantUser(@relation "ApplicationApplicant" -> User),program,documents[],reviews[],offers[],enrollments[]}; ApplicationDocument.application; ApplicationReview.application (reviewerUserId = recorded actor id, NO FK); AdmissionOffer.{application,offeredProgram(@relation "OfferOfferedProgram")}; Enrollment.{application,studentProfile,academicSession} (enrolledByUserId = recorded actor id, NO FK). Back-relations added on Institution (admissionCampaigns/admissionCampaignPrograms/applications/applicationDocuments/applicationReviews/admissionOffers/enrollments), User.applications (@relation "ApplicationApplicant"), StudentProfile.enrollments, AcademicSession.{admissionCampaigns,enrollments}, Program.{admissionCampaigns(@relation "CampaignTargetProgram"),admissionCampaignPrograms,applications,admissionOffers(@relation "OfferOfferedProgram")}. No existing column on student_profiles or users was changed.

KEY DB OBJECTS FEAT-003/004 rely on: partial unique index 'admission_offers_one_live_per_application' ON admission_offers(institutionId,applicationId) WHERE status IN ('ISSUED','ACCEPTED'); unique 'enrollments_institutionId_applicationId_key' (one enrollment per application, idempotency backstop); unique 'applications_institutionId_campaignId_applicantUserId_key' + 'applications_institutionId_applicationNumber_key'; append-only trigger 'application_reviews_no_update_delete' (fn application_reviews_append_only, ERRCODE restrict_violation). RLS: six mutable tables have the standard tenant_isolation_select+tenant_isolation_modify pair; application_reviews has tenant_isolation_select + application_reviews_tenant_insert (INSERT-only, no modify policy), REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE from campass_app. campass_app got full DML on the six mutable tables + SELECT,INSERT on application_reviews; never granted BYPASSRLS.

FOR FEAT-002: section (j) of the migration is a CLEARLY-MARKED PLACEHOLDER comment (admissions.* catalogue seed) intentionally left empty by FEAT-001. FEAT-002 fills it with the pinned literal markers (NEW APPLICANT + ADMISSION_OFFICER template 'roles' rows with institutionId=NULL; admissions.* 'permissions' rows ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING; 'role_permissions' INSERT ... SELECT ... FROM (VALUES ...) AS m("roleKey","permKey") JOIN "roles" r ... JOIN "permissions" p ... ON CONFLICT ("roleId","permissionId") DO NOTHING) in the SAME shape as the phase4/phase5 seed blocks so catalogue-sync.test.ts parses it. NOTE: because this migration is already DEPLOYED to the shared DB, when FEAT-002 edits section (j) of this same migration.sql it must ALSO run the seed separately (e.g. npm run db:seed) against the live DB -- migrate deploy will NOT re-run an already-applied migration. Verification note on the read-only diff: 'prisma migrate diff' renders every hand-authored composite same-tenant FK as a 'removed composite / added single-column FK' line on ALL prior-phase tables too (phase4/phase5 included); this is pre-existing Prisma rendering drift, not a change authored by this migration -- the Phase-6 additions in the diff are exactly the 4 enums + 7 tables + their indexes/FKs.
